files..config/systemd/user/om-autosync.service:
[Unit]
Description=om scheduled GitOps sync

[Service]
Type=oneshot
Environment="OM_HOME=/opt/om-home"
ExecStart="/usr/local/bin/om" "with space" "q\"uote" "50%%" "sync" "--scheduled"
files..config/systemd/user/om-autosync.timer:
[Unit]
Description=om scheduled GitOps sync (timer)

[Timer]
OnBootSec=2min
OnActiveSec=2min
OnUnitActiveSec=1min
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
